cf.meta.title: Cafe Business Model — unit economics calculator | Dykyi Roman
cf.meta.description: Unit-economics calculator for a cafe: P&L of an average month, two break-even points, payback period and sensitivity analysis. Dine-in, takeaway and delivery, staff, taxes, start-up investment, three scenarios.
cf.meta.ogTitle: Cafe Business Model — unit economics calculator
cf.meta.ogDescription: Set the parameters of a cafe and get its P&L, break-even point, payback and the levers that move profit the most. Everything is computed in the browser, nothing is sent to a server.
cf.nav.title: Cafe business model
cf.nav.sub: unit economics before opening — the numbers stay in your browser
cf.topbar.title: Model parameters
cf.start.lead: Fill in the parameters below and press «Calculate». The model returns the P&L of an average month, the break-even point and the payback period, and shows which levers move profit the most. Parameters are saved in the browser automatically; to keep them for good, export the JSON — the same file can be loaded back.
cf.menu.lead: Enter how much a single guest spends on each category on average. The sum of those amounts is the average check — no shares to work out.
cf.capex.lead: Each line has its own depreciation period: a fit-out lasts longer than tableware. The deposit, the opening inventory and the reserve are not depreciated — they are frozen cash, not wear and tear.
cf.scen.lead: Every value is a multiplier on the base parameter: 1 means «as set above», 0.75 is minus 25%, 1.2 is plus 20%. Sensitivity analysis is always computed from the base scenario, so the two never mix.
cf.aria.hours: Bar chart of guest numbers across opening hours, weekdays and weekends separately
cf.aria.water: Waterfall chart: costs are subtracted from revenue step by step down to net profit
cf.aria.donut: Doughnut chart of the cost structure
cf.aria.bep: Revenue and cost lines against guests per day, with their crossing point
cf.aria.tornado: Tornado chart: change in net profit when each parameter moves by ±10 and ±20 percent
cf.aria.scen: Net profit compared across the pessimistic, base and optimistic scenarios
cf.btn.toggleTitle: Hide or show every parameter block
cf.btn.exportTitle: Download parameters and results as one JSON file
cf.btn.resetTitle: Return every field to its original value
cf.status.saved: Showing the calculation from the saved parameters
cf.confirm.reset: Return every parameter to its original value? The current settings will be lost.
cf.toast.notModel: This is not a cafe model file
cf.f.name: Venue name
cf.f.cur.hint: Any symbol or code — no country is hard-wired.
cf.f.closedDays.hint: Holidays, repairs, public holidays. Reduces the number of working days in a month.
cf.f.visitMin.hint: The longer guests sit, the fewer of them pass through the same seat.
cf.f.lastOrder.hint: The last hour serves fewer guests: it is already too late to sit down.
cf.f.waste.hint: Of cost, not of revenue: spoiled food is a purchase that never sold.
cf.f.pack.hint: Real money on every order — not a percentage.
cf.f.ownFc.hint: Empty — the weighted food cost of the menu is used.
cf.f.dlComm.hint: Charged on the full order value including VAT. Card fees are not added on delivery — the aggregator collects the payment.
cf.f.payrollTax.hint: Employer contributions on top of gross pay.
cf.f.vatNote: VAT registered — enter rent, services and cost of goods WITHOUT VAT: input tax is reclaimed and does not affect profit. Not registered — enter everything with VAT.
cf.f.taxRegime.hint: The inactive rate is locked at zero so that nothing is paid twice.
cf.f.levy.hint: A mandatory payment regardless of turnover.
cf.f.adv.vatIn: Input VAT rates — they only affect the memo line «VAT payable»
cf.f.vatInServices: Input VAT on services and rent
cf.presets.label: Fill both grids:
cf.scen.note: Multipliers are applied to the base parameters before the calculation: traffic — to hourly occupancy and order counts, average check — to category spend and channel checks, fixed costs — to the cost lines.
cf.note.days: The profile decides which occupancy grid and which hours apply to a day. A month works out to {days}.
cf.note.daysValue: {wd} weekdays and {we} weekend days, {all} in total
cf.note.turns: A guest occupies a seat for the time set above, so in one hour a single seat serves {turns} guests. The room caps at {cap} guests per hour.
cf.note.menu: Average check {check}, weighted food cost {fcW}, with write-offs {fcEff}. Guests per day — {guests}.
cf.note.staff: Gross payroll {gross}, with taxes {total}, hours per month {hours}.
cf.kpi.safety.d: revenue can fall by this much
cf.pnl.vatMemo: VAT payable (not a cost, but it leaves the account)
cf.bep.note: To break even on cash you need {guests} — that is {occ} occupancy. To cover depreciation on top of that — {guestsAcct}. The plan sits {safety} above the cash threshold, and that is the margin of safety.
cf.bep.infeasible: Careful: that many guests do not fit into the room you have.
cf.bep.cannot: The break-even point cannot be computed.
cf.bep.impossible: Dine-in contribution margin is ≤ 0 — there is no break-even point.
cf.bep.covered: Fixed costs are already covered by takeaway and delivery.
cf.tornado.axis: change in net profit, {cur} per month
cf.sens.note: The saturated part is a ±10% move, the pale one ±20%. Profit is moved most by {top}: ±20% on it is worth {topSpan} a month. Least of all — {bottom} ({bottomSpan}).
cf.warn.noDays: No working day is selected — the whole model is zero.
cf.warn.occHot: Occupancy above 95% for {n} h — practically unreachable.
cf.warn.bepUnreachable: Break-even is unreachable with the current seating and opening hours.
cf.warn.labourLow: Payroll is below 22% of revenue — at this traffic you will most likely need more shifts.
cf.warn.staffHours: Staff hours are fewer than the opening hours — someone is left alone on the floor.
cf.warn.zeroCheck: The average check is zero — fill in the menu categories.
cf.store.failed: Parameters ARE NOT SAVED: the browser rejected both cookies and localStorage. That happens in private mode, under strict privacy settings, or when the file is opened from disk. Everything you enter will be lost on reload — save the model with «Export JSON» or open the page through a local server: python3 -m http.server 8137
cf.store.stale: The saved parameters came from an earlier version of the page — missing fields were taken from the original values. Check them and press «Calculate».
cf.store.oversize: The parameters outgrew the cookie limit (about 4 KB) and are saved only in the localStorage of this browser. That does not affect anything, but a backup via «Export JSON» will not hurt.
cf.store.noCookies: Cookies are unavailable in this mode (usually when the file is opened from disk) — the parameters are saved in localStorage.
